meta.ref: main@bbb3726; decisions and pad-panel re-synced with main@a0e8616 (2026-10-11)

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The brand mark's own blue: the rounded 'M' square on sign-in screens (Tailwind @theme --color-brand). Deliberately not a Tailwind scale value. Never used for buttons or links.

tokens.name: brand-icon
tokens.usage: The fill of the shipped PWA/favicon PNGs (static/icons). Differs from `brand` (#2f80ff) — a discrepancy in the source, kept as found.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tailwind blue-600. Links, eyebrow labels, the active bottom-bar tab, the current approval step, unread dots, signature handles. White text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Tailwind blue-700. Link hover; also the ink of the `info` badge tone.

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: Tailwind blue-100. The 4px ring around the current step marker in the approval stepper.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Tailwind blue-300. 2px focus outline, 1px offset, on every Field.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Theme ink.strong → darkest (slate-900). Titles, figures people scan for, Field values. Also the page's base text colour.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Theme ink.body → dark (slate-700). Text people read or click: menu items, secondary Button label, form labels, comment bodies.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Theme ink.secondary → medium (slate-500). Captions, descriptions, meta lines, table head labels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Theme ink.faint → light (slate-400). Hints, placeholders, decoration only. ≈2.6:1 on white — FAILS WCAG AA for real content; the source flags this itself.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Theme background.raised → lightest (white). Cards, panels, sections, the header and bottom bar, Field fill.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Theme background.base → lighter (slate-50). The page canvas behind everything; also table-head bands and inset wells.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Theme background.sunken → light (slate-100). A board lane or recessed well.

tokens.name: border-divider
tokens.usage: Theme border.divider → faint (slate-100). Row separators inside lists and tables.

tokens.name: border-surface
tokens.usage: Theme border.surface → soft (slate-200). Outlines panels, sections, cards, tiles, popovers; rules bounding a region (header, table head, bottom nav); secondary Button outline.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Theme border.control → defined (slate-300). An input/select/textarea's own box; the dashed ring of a pending Avatar.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill (bg-slate-900) with white text. The primary action is near-black, not blue.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Tailwind slate-800. Primary Button hover.

tokens.name: hover-wash
tokens.usage: Secondary Button and list-row hover fill (hover:bg-slate-50).

tokens.name: avatar-fill
tokens.usage: Avatar circle fill (bg-slate-200) under ink-body initials.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop (backdrop:bg-slate-900/40).

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Tailwind red-700. Danger Button label, `bad` badge ink, negative Metric value, error toast text.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Tailwind red-200. Danger Button outline, error toast border.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Tailwind red-50. Danger Button hover, `bad` badge fill, error toast fill.

tokens.name: tone-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tone `neutral` → palette grey: fill (slate-100). A state with no urgency — a label, not a signal.

tokens.name: tone-neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Badge tone `neutral` → palette grey: text (slate-600) on tone-neutral-bg.

tokens.name: tone-info-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tone `info` → palette blue: fill (blue-50). In progress, awaiting someone.

tokens.name: tone-info-ink
tokens.usage: Badge tone `info`: text (blue-700) on tone-info-bg.

tokens.name: tone-good-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tone `good` → palette green: fill (emerald-50). Approved, complete.

tokens.name: tone-good-ink
tokens.usage: Badge tone `good`: text (emerald-700); also a positive Metric value.

tokens.name: tone-bad-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tone `bad` → palette red: fill (red-50). Rejected, overdue.

tokens.name: tone-bad-ink
tokens.usage: Badge tone `bad`: text (red-700).

tokens.name: tone-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tone `warn` → palette amber: fill (amber-50). Needs attention, not yet a failure. Also the truncation notice fill.

tokens.name: tone-warn-ink
tokens.usage: Badge tone `warn`: text (amber-800).

tokens.name: tone-warn-border
tokens.usage: Tailwind amber-200. Border of the 'Showing the first N only' truncation notice.

tokens.name: tone-muted-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tone `muted` → palette grey-faint: fill (slate-50). Absent / not applicable — deliberately distinct from neutral.

tokens.name: tone-muted-ink
tokens.usage: Badge tone `muted`: text (slate-400). Low contrast by design (de-emphasised); never for content that must be read.

tokens.name: mark-good
tokens.usage: Emerald-600. Isi padat penanda selesai: lingkaran ceklis, titik status 'approved', bar kemajuan. DINAMAI DI LUAR SKEMA `tone-*` dengan sengaja — tone adalah pasangan bg/ink yang bisa ditimpa Workspace lewat `theme.tone`, sedangkan ini satu warna isi untuk grafik kecil dan tidak punya pasangan. Menamainya `tone-good-solid` akan menjanjikan mekanisme override yang tidak ada. DITERIMA 7 Okt 2026, menggantikan usulan dua langkah (emerald-500 ditolak: ~2.1:1 di atas putih, gagal 3:1 untuk grafik bermakna / WCAG 1.4.11). Belum ada di kode (@bbb3726). Bukti: 83 pemakaian, 2 dari 3 layar audit. Di kode sejak 11–12 Okt 2026: reader markGoodFill/markGoodBorder (internal/rendering/layout.templ), dijaga TestNoHandWrittenMarkGood.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: text.display → huge (text-2xl). A Metric tile's headline number, emphasis weight.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: text.heading → large (text-xl). A screen's own title (<h1>), emphasis weight.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: text.subheading → medium (text-base). One section's title inside a screen.

styles.name: panel-heading
styles.usage: Body size at emphasis weight — a panel's own title (StaticPanelHeading). Kept separate from subheading pending owner decision D7.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Submit a document and choose who signs it, in order.
styles.usage: text.body → normal (text-sm). Prose, row content, Button and Field text. The most used size (194 sites).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: text.meta → small (text-xs). A date, a count, a project name beside something else.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: text.label → tiny (text-2xs, custom 0.6875rem). Text inside a badge or pill — short, never a sentence.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Choose a strong password you don't use elsewhere.
styles.usage: text.caption → tiny (text-2xs). The one-sentence help line under a block title or control, in ink-secondary.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: text.eyebrow → micro (text-3xs, custom 0.625rem), uppercase, tracking-wide, in `accent`. The line naming what a screen belongs to. The faint variant (Overline) uses ink-faint.

styles.name: brand-glyph
styles.usage: The white 'M' inside the 44px brand square. The only use of weight 700.

styles.name: auth-heading
styles.usage: Pre-auth screen title under the brand mark (text-[21px], one-off).

styles.name: auth-subtitle
styles.sample: Use the account your workspace admin invited.
styles.usage: Pre-auth subtitle in ink-secondary (text-[15px]); 15px is also the mobile touch-target Field size.

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 base unit is 0.25rem (4px). Gap and padding are Theme roles; amounts are named in words in Go (two, three…) and map 1:1 to Tailwind steps.

tokens.name: gap-tight
tokens.usage: Theme gap.tight → two (gap-2). Icon + label, badge rows.

tokens.name: gap-default
tokens.usage: Theme gap.default → three (gap-3). The default stack/row/grid gap; an empty Gap means this.

tokens.name: gap-comfortable
tokens.usage: Theme gap.comfortable → four (gap-4). Between panels on approval screens.

tokens.name: gap-loose
tokens.usage: Theme gap.loose → five (gap-5). Split layouts on New Application screens.

tokens.name: pad-panel
tokens.usage: Theme padding.panel → five (p-5). panelLayout's padding on all sides. Equal to pad-section since owner decision D6 (7 Oct 2026); was 16px (p-4).

tokens.name: pad-section
tokens.usage: Theme padding.section → five (p-5). sectionLayout's padding. Equal to pad-panel since D6 (7 Oct 2026); the two stay separate roles a Workspace can declare apart.

tokens.name: pad-metric
tokens.usage: Metric tile padding (p-3, hand-set).

tokens.name: pad-badge-x
tokens.usage: Theme padding.badge-x → two-half (px-2.5). Regular StatusBadge side room.

tokens.name: pad-badge-y
tokens.usage: Theme padding.badge-y → one (py-1). Regular StatusBadge top/bottom.

tokens.name: pad-badge-compact-x
tokens.usage: Theme padding.badge-compact-x → two (px-2).

tokens.name: pad-badge-compact-y
tokens.usage: Theme padding.badge-compact-y → half (py-0.5).

tokens.name: pad-control-x
tokens.usage: Button side padding (px-4). Fields use 12px (px-3).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of every Button and Field (h-9). Mobile auth Fields grow to 42px (h-10.5).

tokens.name: brand-mark-size
tokens.usage: The brand square on auth screens (size-11).

tokens.name: gap-region
tokens.usage: Satu langkah di atas `gap-loose` (gap-6). Memisah region besar dalam satu layar — daftar dari panel samping, header dari isi. DITERIMA 7 Okt 2026: memperpanjang ujung tangga, bukan menyisipkan langkah di tengahnya. Belum ada di kode (@bbb3726). Bukti: 3 dari 3 layar audit.

tokens.name: control-height-compact
tokens.usage: Tinggi kontrol kecil: tombol ikon, chip filter, pil yang bisa ditekan di dalam baris. Melengkapi `control-height` 36px dan 42–44px. DITERIMA 7 Okt 2026: kontrol bertingkat (kecil/standar/sentuh) adalah praktik baku. SYARAT: hanya untuk penunjuk presisi (mouse). Di layar sentuh, area tekannya harus tetap 44×44px lewat padding transparan — 32px sendiri melanggar WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size. Belum ada di kode (@bbb3726).

tokens.name: gap-xtight
tokens.usage: Satu langkah di bawah `gap-tight` (gap-1.5). Hanya untuk pasangan ikon/dot dengan labelnya di dalam komponen padat yang lebarnya terkunci — header lane papan, baris kartu, chip status. Bukan untuk jarak antar komponen; di layar yang lapang pakai `gap-tight`. Di kode sejak 11 Okt 2026: peran Theme domain.GapXtight → gap-1.5 (13 situs inline; 9 jarak antar-komponen sengaja tidak).
tokens.evidence: Sempat ditolak dengan alasan 8px sudah cukup. Uji coba 7 Okt 2026 membantahnya: menaikkan 268 titik dari 6px ke 8px membuat judul lane 'Pre-production' dan judul kartu di papan Project Management (lane 182px) pecah ke baris tambahan. 6px memang menanggung beban layout di permukaan padat, jadi token ini diterima dengan ruang lingkup yang jelas.

tokens.name: gap-micro
tokens.usage: Theme gap.micro → one (gap-1). Ujung bawah tangga gap: judul dengan subjudulnya, label dengan nilainya, ikon kecil dengan teksnya. Ditambahkan 12 Okt 2026 (keputusan pemilik G1), memperpanjang ujung bawah tangga seperti gap-region memperpanjang ujung atasnya. Di kode: domain.GapMicro, 79 situs.

tokens.name: gap-hair
tokens.usage: Theme gap.hair → half (gap-0.5). Langkah terkecil: baris teks bertumpuk yang rapat (nama dan email, label dan keterangannya). Ditambahkan 12 Okt 2026 (keputusan pemilik G1). Di kode: domain.GapHair, 31 situs.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Theme radius.control → small (rounded-md). Buttons, Fields, and small tiles inside a surface.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: Theme radius.surface → large (rounded-lg). Panels, sections, cards, Metric tiles, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Theme radius.pill → full (rounded-full). StatusBadges, Avatars, step markers.

tokens.name: radius-brand-mark
tokens.usage: The brand 'M' square (rounded-[10px], one-off).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the mobile bottom sheet (rounded-t-2xl).

shadow.note: Shadow is deliberately NOT a Theme category in the source; these are the few hand-set shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-hover

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: shadow-lg: menus, filter popovers, the signature dialog, desktop 'More' panel.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The mobile bottom sheet, lifting upward.

rejected.note: Nilai yang DITOLAK untuk sebuah makna. Bukan token untuk dipakai: dicatat agar tidak masuk kembali diam-diam. Kode dijaga gerbang GS2 (TestRejectedDesignValuesStayOut).

tokens.name: body-compact
tokens.usage: DITOLAK 7 Okt 2026 sebagai langkah tipe di antara meta 12 dan body 14: menyisipkan langkah di tengah tangga merusak skala, dan tabel padat diatasi dengan mengurangi padding. Gantinya: body 14 / meta 12. Di kode: text-[13px].

tokens.name: mark-good-500
tokens.usage: DITOLAK untuk isi penanda selesai: emerald-500 hanya 2,46:1 di atas putih (diukur 12 Okt 2026), di bawah 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11. Gantinya: mark-good (emerald-600, 3,67:1). Di kode: bg-/border-emerald-500.
